notes: Printed: '{5}{G}, {T}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' The library top-first is C1, C2, Meadow (a land), C3, C4, C5: the four looked at are C1, C2, Meadow, C3. The player takes creature C2 into hand (the land is not takeable; C4, the fifth card, is not among the four); the rest go to the bottom in random order with no arrange ask (a further ask would have no word and fail the pack). The fifth card (C4) was never looked at, so it is still on top: the next draw takes it.
